svg.title: MerchantPay system architecture
svg.desc: MerchantPay dev/v3 reference architecture based on the Kubernetes workload template. The default payment path uses a signed HTTP API and MySQL durable tasks. Optional four-source, outbox CDC, projection and Flink analytics paths are shown separately. The optional V2 single-primary HA profile is a separate deployment profile.
svg.metadata: MerchantPay dev/v3. Repository evidence: infra/k8s/v3/workloads.yaml; infra/ha/application-v2-ha.yaml; infra/ha/mysql-common.cnf; platform PaymentService, OutboxService, TaskWorker, ChannelGateway, InboxService and NotificationService; docs/api/sharding-api.md; docs/releases/v3-analytics.md.
svg.text: Raw receipt first. Success commits state, balanced ledger and outgoing event together.
Activation requires the corresponding flags and deployment gates.
Core 0 directory · 16 logical buckets · route epoch & ACTIVE fence
SQL to the selected owner. Each physical database has its own transactions.
Alternative event transport · the emitted topic identifies its source
Separate CDC connectors for payments ×4 and the Core 0 route table
Aggregates feed preliminary reconciliation. MySQL is the ledger authority.
Workloads manifest · payment/outbox implementation · V3 release contracts
